autoOCExport.name: NVDA Price Alert
autoOCExport.description: Sample task that checks the NVDA stock price and alerts when it drops below $172.

tasks.name: NVDA price check
tasks.prompt: Check the current price of NVDA at https://es.finance.yahoo.com/quote/NVDA/. Tell me the exact price you find. I do not want it to drop below $172, so if the price is under $172, clearly alert me and briefly suggest what to watch next.
